statements.statement: A member recalled the schools had reported a shortfall going into the FY26 town meeting, cited as context for how contested the building-project vote was.
A member said the school funding override was the main reason the town-hall/Ritter building question was so close at town meeting and then failed at the ballot.

warnings.about: stacking capital overrides for town facilities (Town Hall/Ritter, Turkey Hill, primary-school intersection, fire station, Eagle House)
warnings.prediction: the town could 'override the citizens to death' if multiple building/infrastructure overrides are pursued without a set priority order
